summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to allow taxpayers to deduct up to $4,000 annually for rent paid on their primary residence, with income limitations, for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2026.

scores.thoughts: This bill creates a new tax deduction for rent payments, which would reduce the taxable income for eligible individuals. This directly leads to lower tax liabilities for those who qualify.

The bill creates a new above-the-line tax deduction for rent payments (up to $4,000, with income phaseouts), which reduces federal tax revenue with no offsetting revenue raisers or spending cuts. This is the sole purpose of the legislation.
